title: Freya and the Protocol
author: Theo Eriksen
blurb: Paloma Vane, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
